card.title: PS5 EDM-010 Mainboard Component Architecture Map

claims.statement: The image identifies the physical location of major components on the PS5 EDM-010 motherboard.
claims.evidence: Labels point to specific silicon and connector areas including APU, Southbridge, Power Management, and memory controllers.

card.caveats: This image is a component identification map and does not provide voltage, resistance, or signal measurements.
